applies_to: P1 ICP bench on main eef8b85 / execution branch f7d945b

P1Q-15.sign_convention: one global convention for every ICP-45 capacity record: conventional current INTO the defined isolated electrical network is positive; every channel transformed into it before analysis
P1Q-15.terms: signed I_ecollector, I_H1,body, I_anode, I_facility, I_ICP,body and any other intentional terminal crossing the registered network boundary, where physically present/measurable
P1Q-15.floating_anode: I_anode ~ 0 by construction in the floating-anode ICP45_CAPACITY baseline; its potential is still recorded
P1Q-15.no_silent_zero: an unavailable current channel is never silently set to zero
P1Q-15.uncertainty: u_R = sqrt(sum_k u^2(I_k)) for independent calibrated channels, each u(I_k) including calibration, zero/offset, resolution, repeatability where applicable and any registered RF-pickup contribution; full covariance form when correlations are established
P1Q-15.admission: closure-valid only if |R_I| <= 3 u_R AND |R_I| / max(I_e,collector, I_scale,min) <= 0.02; I_scale,min is a small registered denominator floor from instrument capability (value registered, not set here)
P1Q-15.instrument_adequacy: if 3 u_R > 0.02 I_e,collector at a candidate qualification point, the point is NOT_EVALUATED_INSTRUMENT; the tolerance is never widened; the 2 % criterion is never relaxed after observing propulsion results
exclusions: current sign conventions differ between channels
an intentional return path is unmeasured
an unintended ground path is found
H-1 anode not physically disconnected/floating in an ICP45_CAPACITY record
P1Q-15.excluded_points: remain in the raw record with the exclusion reason

P1Q-16.formula: I_e,cap = I_e,collector,RFON - I_e,collector,RFOFF (the A9.4 recorder reading, confirmed; the verbatim block again lacks 'I_e,cap =' and the minus sign), signed currents under the same registered convention
rules: the RF-OFF term estimates facility/background electron collection
Hall-ON measurements remain NEUTRALIZATION_CONSISTENCY and never define I_e,cap
P1Q-16.evaluation: M_n = I_e,cap / I_d,max,H1 - 1; ICP-45A eligible only when (1) the capacity point passes current closure, (2) the matched RF-OFF correction is valid, (3) all required uncertainties are available, (4) I_d,max,H1 is registered; then the preregistered one-sided lower bound M_n,LB > 0; until all four exist ICP45 = NOT_EVALUATED

execution.instruction: 'fix all the issues' - apply P1Q-15/P1Q-16 to the P1 bench package and fix the carried A9.4 minors (P2 stale PENDING RFQ references, P1-S4 leftover PROPOSED collector wording, INS-P2-10 source list)
